title: Real futures Turtle baseline (long/short x signal/sizing)
dataset: user_data/data_p3 (genuine Binance USDT-M futures OHLCV, 4h, 10 perps)
command_template: python -m freqtrade backtesting --userdir user_data -d user_data/data_p3 --strategy-path research_lib/strategies -c user_data/configs/P3-EXP-001.json --strategy <ARM> --timerange <WINDOW> --cache none --export trades --fee 0.0005

key_finding_signal_vs_sizing.statement: On the same signal, fixed-notional sizing beat volatility-scaled sizing on profit factor, drawdown and significance; the volatility-scaled compounded headline is a sizing/compounding artifact.

acceptance.oos_expectancy: FAIL (negative for both long arms, all short arms)

decision: FAIL. Genuine-futures Turtle does not show a robust positive OOS edge in either direction; the short side is negative throughout; volatility-scaled sizing worsened PF/drawdown versus fixed notional. No long Turtle configuration may be promoted; no combination may proceed on this basis.
next_experiment: P3-EXP-002 (cost/slippage robustness of the long baseline)
